about: Rivne: a green city and Polissia plots

Rivne is a green city of parks and apartment-block estates, where many new residential complexes have appeared in recent years. The suburbs and the surrounding Polissia region are private houses on large plots among forests and marshes.
Polissia plots often have high groundwater and peat soils. Getting the foundation and drainage right is critical here, and we settle them before any interior decisions.

For Rivne apartments — a functional layout, storage and light; for houses — a warm palette with wood, a fireplace and large windows onto the garden. You can choose the planning, basic or full package with designer supervision. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments and houses, from new services to finishing. We build aerated-block, brick, timber-frame and log houses; the foundation is designed after the site survey data — see also [house design](/en/house-design).

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
